primary: Corrupted LPIPS vs baseline and equal-capacity no-target control, subject to PSNR/FaceNet tolerances
limitations: Four observed identities and one seed, not independent confirmation
Identity failures retained; paired support reported
Canonical adapter rectangles are not anatomical alignment
no_target ablates explicit target similarity and pose features but retains minimum target/reference detection confidence; it is not a strictly target-free control
Conditions and timestep blocks are coupled during this pilot training; broader independent corruption/timestep sampling remains
No frozen final evaluation or new dataset used
